value.description: We refuse to tolerate the predations of the vampires. These parasitic creatures thrive on the suffering of others, spreading their cursed condition like a plague. Our mission is clear: track them, eliminate them, and ensure their kind finds no safe haven under the stars.

value.li: lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->Only by standing together and taking action can we protect ourselves from the vampire threat.
archistBasis(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->The archotechs have no tolerance for vampires. Their parasitic nature is an antithesis to perfection.
archistFact(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->When the archotechs reveal their grand design, those who stood against vampires will be rewarded for their vigilance.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will eliminate all vampires and elevate the hunters who aided in their extermination.
animistFact(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->The spirits abhor vampires, for their thirst for blood disrupts the natural order of life and death.
serketistProphecy(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting)->As predators prey upon the weak, so must we hunt the vampires to maintain the balance of the ecosystem.
chthonianProphecy(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting)->The vampires are a whisper of the cosmic madness that threatens to consume us all. By hunting them, we deny the abyss its agents.
esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting)->The vampires covet secrets that were never meant to be theirs. By ending their existence, we preserve the sacred knowledge of the unseen.
eschatologismFact(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting)->The vampires herald the end. To delay the apocalypse, we must extinguish their cursed bloodlines.
creation(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->[deity0_name] gazed upon the cursed vampires and proclaimed: "These creatures are an affront to life itself. They must be purged to restore balance."

introMemo(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting)->It has come to my attention that some of you have been avoiding assignments to hunt vampires. Let me remind you: no one is exempt from safeguarding our colony. Remember: teamwork keeps the parasites at bay!
alienistProphecy(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting)->We will capture and study these creatures, learning from them and perhaps discover a way to better end the threat of vampires.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->[deity0_name] said to the [memberNamePlural]: "Hunt the vampires wherever they hide. Their bloodlust defiles the sanctity of creation."
intro(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->[memberNamePlural] constructed a solemn [altarName] on the [place_summary] [place_name], where they swore an oath to cleanse the land of vampires.
conflict(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->The vampires retaliated against [deity0_name]'s followers, but the [memberNamePlural] stood firm, vowing to end their reign of terror.
founderJoin(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->[deity0_name] commanded [founderName] to rise against the vampires, calling them the bane of mortal existence.
victory(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->[founderName] led a crusade against the vampires, vanquishing them and securing a lasting peace for the faithful.

setup(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->Our founder [founderName] was a visionary who saw the danger of vampires in [founder_possessive] world. [founder_pronoun] gathered [founder_possessive] followers and set out to eradicate this parasitic menace.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->[founderName]'s followers documented [founder_possessive] tactics and strategies, passing down the art of vampire hunting through the generations.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_SanguophageHunting) ->In all my years tracking vampires, one truth has become clear:

value.description:
Our purpose is clear: to seek out the cursed vampires wherever they may hide.

Normal Vampires will be the focus of this precept.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - All attacks against a Vampire will cause extra 10 burn damage.
 - You'll get extra hunt focus precepts with VE Races - Vampire and Alpha Genes.

The lurking dens of vampires are a blight upon the world, festering with unnatural corruption. We take pride in raiding these camps, striking at their cursed kind.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - If this precept is active in your colony, you will get Vampire camp quests once per quadrum. These are storyteller-independent, they don't take the "slot" of a base game quest.

value.li: questDescription(askerIsNull==true)->Our trackers have discovered footprints that seem to lead to a Vampire camp nestled near [map_definite]. The area shows signs of recent activity, and it seems the camp may be built around an old crypt. These creatures are a danger to all, and their lair might hold valuable relics or technology worth recovering. Be prepared for resistance, as the Vampires will not give up their stronghold without a fight.

value.description: We have a torpor casket in the colony. This is blasphemy, it should be dismantled as soon as possible.
It's been more than three quadrums since our colony has killed a Vampire... What kind of hunters are we?
